newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nth Asia demand to boost Australia beef-ABARE.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nth Asia demand to boost Australia beef-ABARE.

text.p: Growth in North Asian demand would increase returns to Australian beef producers over the next few years, Terry Sheales, the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics' (ABARE) chief commodity analyst said on Thursday.
Demand growth was expected to be particularly strong from Japan and South Korea, with competition U.S. beef in those markets expected to remain intense, he told the ABARE Outlook conference.
Forecast rising prices over the next few years would be in contrast to low returns over the past year, he said.
Growth of the live cattle trade was a positive development for beef producers in northern Australia, he said.
Strong demand for feeder cattle from South East Asia would ensure further growth in the trade, he said.
However, returns in the sheep meat industry were projected to fall over the medium term.
Pig and poultry prices would also slip as production rose and competition intensified in the domestic market, he said.
